title: Cyber Defenders Unit 5 · Kind screens, safe chats (3-5)

items.q: A player you have never met in real life is friendly in a game chat. What is true about them?
choices: They are a friend because they are kind
They are still a stranger, however friendly they seem
They may know your school already
They can be trusted after one game

items.q: A chat friend says: 'Let's move to a private chat, and keep it secret from your parents.' What is this?
choices: A normal way to make friends
A prize for playing well
A warning sign: leave the chat and tell a trusted adult
A rule of the game you must follow

items.q: Someone in a chat asks which school you go to. What should you do?
choices: Answer, because it is only a small fact
Ask where they go first
Leave the chat; blocking is a lock, not rudeness
Move to a private chat to answer

items.q: A mean message about a classmate lands in the class game chat. What should you do first?
choices: Forward it so others can judge
Join in with a joke
Save the message and tell a trusted adult
Reply with something meaner

items.q: What does an upstander do when a message turns mean?
choices: Says a kind word to the person it hurt
Laughs along quietly
Sends the message to more people
Waits to see who wins

items.q: You sent a mean message too fast and now feel bad about it. What is the Defender repair path?
choices: Delete your account and say nothing
Hope nobody saved it
Stop, say sorry, delete it, and tell a trusted adult
Send another message blaming a friend

items.q: After a long game your eyes are sore and you feel grumpy. What are these?
choices: Signs your body sends that it is break time
Proof the game is badly made
A reason to play faster
Badges you earned in the game

items.q: When is the best moment to choose your stopping point for a game?
choices: When you feel too tired to stop
Before you start playing
After the third just-one-more
Never; stopping ruins the fun

items.q: A game praises your seven-day streak and warns you will lose it if you stop tonight. What is the streak doing?
choices: Teaching you a safety rule
Counting for your teacher
Trying to keep you playing with just-one-more pressure
Nothing; streaks cannot affect choices
